composition_notes: An eight-bar ground supports four complete statements with changing texture, followed by a restrained closing episode.
The eight-bar bass ground is preserved. The long-note variations gain a continuous upper melody and prepared suspensions before the restrained close.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
